[P2] Add caller/callee integration coverage for propagation

This fake client completes invokes without running a callee. The new sampling-authority suite also fakes that boundary, while the serializer regression checks only outgoing JSON. These tests therefore pass if delivery drops `XAmznTraceId`, loses `Sampled=0`, or fails to connect the target to the calling operation. CONTRIBUTING.md requires integration coverage for public API changes. Add a deployed caller/callee example and integration test that captures the received carrier and verifies trace identity, calling-operation ancestry, and sampled/unsampled behavior for both OTel views.
